posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra as a frontier computer-use model and the first to hit Critical cybersecurity. Brockman framed it as the AGI era; Daybreak first, then Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise and API.

posts.title: Nvidia confirms $12.9B Hugging Face buy
posts.summary: Nvidia will acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B; hub stays multi-vendor/open without requiring Nvidia compute; close targeted H1 2027.

posts.title: Altman apologizes for messy Astra rollout
posts.summary: Altman apologized for a messy Astra rollout that locked out many paying users; hoped weekend access; offered banked resets per day without access.

posts.title: Accel eyes $1B Thinking Machines round at $40B
posts.summary: Accel reportedly in talks to lead a $1B raise for Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines at ≥$40B.

posts.title: Crusoe raises $3B at $30B valuation
posts.summary: AI data-center builder Crusoe reportedly raised $3B at $30B; customers include Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI.

posts.title: Google Photos lands in Gemini Spark
posts.summary: Google Photos rolling into Gemini Spark for AI Pro/Ultra in the US — search, organize, curate via the agent.

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 — best config still gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 ships coding/agent gains; strongest max-reasoning config still in safety testing. API $1.25/$4.25 per MTok.

posts.title: Abliteration.ai sells de-guardrailed models
posts.summary: Abliteration.ai commercializes stripping open-weight refusals; hosts modified models including GLM-5.3 via API/browser.

posts.title: Meta Muse Voice Transcribe at $0.18/hour
posts.summary: Muse Voice Transcribe at $0.18/hour with real-time diarization for 20+ speakers.

posts.title: Microsoft Project Zenith for AI PCs
posts.summary: Microsoft named distraction-free Windows for developers Project Zenith — high-memory AI PCs for 30B+ local models.

posts.title: Meta discounts Muse Spark for training data
posts.summary: Contributor tier ~95% off ($0.10/$0.20) if you share prompts/outputs; standard stays $1.25/$4.25.

posts.title: Perplexity Hybrid Compute keeps files local
posts.summary: Perplexity Computer can hand confidential steps to on-device models on Apple silicon Macs; Pro/Max + opt-in enterprise on macOS 15+.

posts.title: Anthropic cuts Fable 5.1 cache reads 75%
posts.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 cache hits drop to $0.25/MTok from $1.00 — 2.5% of the $10 input price — better long-context agent economics.

posts.title: LLaDA-Image — 6B open image generator
posts.summary: Ant Group’s inclusionAI released LLaDA-Image, a 6B open-weight gen/edit model plus 4-step Turbo. Qwen-Image-Bench ~53.5 EN / 53.4 ZH.

posts.title: K2 Horizon — six fully open models to 375B
posts.summary: IFM released six Apache-2.0 models (0.9B–375B) with weights, training code, data mixtures, and eval logs.

posts.title: Claude Code 2.1.260 — live /diff panel
posts.summary: Claude Code adds /diff for uncommitted changes beside chat, plus a fix for permission paths with parentheses.

posts.title: Cohere ATE maps 696k MCP tools to jobs
posts.summary: Cohere Labs’ Agentic Task Ecosystem links 696,291 tools across 123,069 MCP servers to O*NET tasks; only 2.6% finish a task end to end.

posts.title: Astra hits 99.9% ARC-AGI-3 with harness
posts.summary: ARC Prize: Astra 62.7% standard harness (~$26k) vs 99.9% Provider Adapter harness (~$19k) on ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private.

posts.title: DeepSeek plans 160k Huawei chips for Mongolia DC
posts.summary: DeepSeek plans ≥160,000 Huawei AI chips at an Inner Mongolia data center amid Nvidia export curbs. (Prismix)

posts.title: ByteDance secures ~$30B loan for AI spend
posts.summary: ByteDance borrowing ~$30B — its biggest loan — as AI infrastructure spend ramps. (Prismix)
